meta.title: Download {appName} — Free on iPhone, Android & Web
meta.description: Download {appName} free on the App Store or Google Play, or open the web app. No ads and no account needed. Also on Apple Watch, Wear OS and TV.

title: Get the app
intro: {appName} runs on iPhone, iPad, Android, the web, Apple Watch, Wear OS, Apple TV and Android TV. Install from the stores or start in your browser.

web.name: Web app (PWA)
web.description: Use {appName} in any modern browser. Works offline as a progressive web app with notification support and the full learning library.

ios.name: iPhone & iPad
ios.description: Native tabs, haptics, compass Qibla, widgets, Live Activities, Siri shortcuts, the Salah focus lock, app lock, and Sign in with Apple.

android.name: Android
android.description: Phones and tablets, with compass Qibla, home-screen widgets, Live Updates, Assistant shortcuts, the Salah focus lock, app lock, and Google sign-in.

watch.name: Apple Watch & Wear OS
watch.description: See the next Salah and mark it from your wrist, with complications on Apple Watch and Salah and Tasbeeh tiles on Wear OS. Installs alongside the phone app.
watch.how: The Apple Watch app installs with the iPhone app. On Wear OS, install it from Google Play on your phone or watch.

tv.name: Apple TV & Android TV
tv.description: Read the Qur'an, follow adhkar and check your tracker on the big screen, designed for the remote.
tv.how: On your TV, open the App Store or Google Play and search for {appName}.

items.web: Web: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge (latest two versions)
items.ios: iPhone and iPad: iOS 16.4 or later (widgets and Live Activities need iOS 17)
items.watch: Apple Watch: watchOS 10 or later · Wear OS: Android 11 (API 30) or later
items.tv: Apple TV: tvOS 17 or later · Android TV: Android 12 (API 31) or later
items.internet: Internet required only for sign-in, sync, and on-demand content downloads

guest.heading: Guest mode
guest.body: No account needed for personal use. Install or open the app and start tracking straight away. Export a local backup anytime, or sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook to sync your Salah, Qaza, Zikr and learning progress across devices, or to use family circles, an accountability partner and group khatm.

items.desktop: Computer (Chrome or Edge): click Install in the address bar.
items.iphone: iPhone and iPad: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
items.mac: Mac (Safari): choose File, then Add to Dock.
items.android: Android: open the browser menu (⋮) and tap Install app.
